articles.summary: Crescent Energy Company (NYSE: CRGY) (Crescent or the Company) today announced financial and operating results for the third quarter of 2026. Crescents earnings release and supplemental earnings presentation can be found at www.crescentenergyco.com . The Companys third quarter 2026 conference call is planned for 10 a.m. CT (11 a.m. ET) on Tuesday, November 3, 2026. About Crescent Energy Company Crescent is a differentiated energy company committed to delivering value through a disciplined, returns-driven growth through acquisition strategy and consistent return of capital. Our long-life, balanced portfolio combines significant cash flow from stable production with deep, high-quality development inventory. articles.summary: Crescent Energy Company (Crescent) announced today that, as permitted under the Jumpstart Our Business Startups Act, it has caused its indirect subsidiary, Crescent Royalty Company (Crescent Royalties), to confidentially submit a draft registration statement on Form S-1 with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (the SEC) for a proposed initial public offering of Crescent Royalties Class A common stock, par value $0.0001 per share (Class A Common Stock), to be created and issued in connection therewith. The assets being considered for initial contribution to Crescent Royalties in connection with the proposed initial public offering are mineral and royalty interests in the Eagle Ford, with additional exposure to other premier oil and natural gas basins in the United States, including the Permian, Appalachian and Denver-Julesburg Basins.
